about_pullquote: We treat every job like it's our own home — honest, fast, and fair.
about_para_1: Johnson Plumbing and Heating Ltd has been serving Blackpool homes and businesses for over 18 years. Started by a father-and-son team frustrated by overpriced cowboys, we've built our reputation on showing up on time, doing the job right, and charging what we actually quote. Today we're the go-to emergency plumber for thousands of Blackpool households.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we answer 24/7, arrive fast, and solve most problems in one visit. We're Gas Safe Registered, carry our own parts, and stand behind every job with a guarantee. You won't find hidden charges or pressure sales here — just honest plumbers who know the trade inside out.
reviews_heading: What Blackpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe on Christmas Eve. Called Johnson Plumbing at 10pm and they were here by 11. Fixed it in under an hour and wouldn't charge us extra for the emergency call. Absolute lifesaver. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using them for years now. Annual boiler service is always thorough, and when my radiator started leaking last winter they came out same day. Fair prices, no faffing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine W.

reviews.text: New boiler installation took one day. The lads were tidy, professional, and explained everything clearly. 10-year guarantee on the unit gives real peace of mind. Really pleased with the job.
reviews.author: David P.
